STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her book shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never her form costume, never a carried book. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

WORLD: this scene happens inside the world of «오페라의 유령», as if she simply lives there — the gilded grand staircase of a Paris opera house, a vast crystal chandelier overhead. Its architecture, props, light and weather show the world; no characters or creatures from the story, no text.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: the place named in WORLD
Outfit: a bikini joined at the centre and hips by polished metal rings
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too — only her eyes turn toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is raised beside her face, waving.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
LEGS: rising onto her toes.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: low — mostly covered clothing, limited neck/hand exposure unless outfit is explicit
action_level: balanced — a readable moment of gentle movement, not a ratio of multiple images
source_influence: strong — her book is clearly recognizable through a few accessories and props in the scene, never through the outfit's colours, patterns or cut; no new armor or carried books
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless the chosen Outfit names a one-piece garment, which wins

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her book belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her and never a character from her book. No text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
